facts.text: Serve the lunch when the crew takes a break between cars.
facts.why: The crew eat lunch on shift in the transcript, with ribs, a spoilt lunch and the Chinese or Italian order, so a lunch break at the car wash is true to the film.
facts.fix: Serve the lunch when T.C. waits on the radio contest call.

facts.text: A second chance means you show up tomorrow. Grab a burger first.
facts.why: Lonnie never says this. It is printed in quote marks as his words. Lonnie is the ex-convict foreman trying to stay on the right side of his parole officer, so a note in his voice is true to the character.
facts.fix: A second chance means showing up tomorrow. Grab a burger first.
